attchmntText: Yuken India Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Yuken India Limited submitted its Statement of Deviation or Variation in the utilization of issue proceeds for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company raised INR 5,991.84 Lakhs through preferential allotment on July 24, 2025, to Yuken Kogyo Co. Ltd., Japan. The company confirms there has been no deviation or variation in the utilization of these funds from the objects stated in the relevant fund-raising documents. The proceeds are being utilized for expanding business activities and commencing the manufacturing of new products for export to Yuken Group companies and other customers. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee, which recorded nil comments. The funds raised were allocated for the stated objects, with INR 5,186.63 Lakhs utilized as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Yuken India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Yuken India Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 16,039.13 lakhs. Profit after tax for the quarter was 697.01 lakhs. For the half year, revenue was 29,471.81 lakhs. Half year profit after tax was 1,217.75 lakhs. The results include a Limited Review Report from Walker Chandiok & Co LLP. The auditor noted that financial results for three subsidiaries and two associates were reviewed by other auditors or management. The conclusion is not modified regarding reliance on these reports. The company is a manufacturer of oil hydraulic equipment. The registered office is in Bengaluru.
